verdict.rationale: Pilot's core service model is human bookkeepers and CFOs, not an AI agent; the only AI-assistant hint is 'Instant AI answers about past transactions and current cash flow, plus run scenarios to plan ahead' which is closer to a query/insights tool than true task delegation to an autonomous assistant. Missing for 10: documentation of an actual conversational/agentic AI assistant that can perform delegated actions (not just answer questions), evidence of scope/capabilities of this AI feature, and independent user reports confirming its use.
